moto-gloves-spearmint.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Spearmint
moto-gloves-spearmint.desc:
These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph. White leather and red stitching make these gloves as stylish as they are comfortable.

For what he's charging us, you'd think Huxley could at least throw in a tin of mints... - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

ak-47-the-oligarch.name: AK-47 | The Oligarch
ak-47-the-oligarch.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted to replicate the look and feel of a luxury white and black puffer jacket and finished with gold accents.

Seek power, gain power, hold power

ak-47-aquamarine-revenge.name: AK-47 | Aquamarine Revenge
ak-47-aquamarine-revenge.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with the image of a pod of dolphins.

Is there an echo in here?

ak-47-black-laminate.name: AK-47 | Black Laminate
ak-47-black-laminate.desc: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been given a laminate stock.

aug-sand-storm.name: AUG | Sand Storm
aug-sand-storm.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A custom paint job depicting a passing sand storm underneath the night sky has been applied.

There is beauty all around us, you just have to know where to look

awp-printstream.name: AWP | Printstream
awp-printstream.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a stark black and white design and finished with pearlescent highlights.

WHITE_1; BLACK_1; PEARLESCENT_1; BOLTACTION_1;

pp-bizon-bamboo-print.name: PP-Bizon | Bamboo Print
pp-bizon-bamboo-print.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted with a hydrographic of brush-painted bamboo.

Insert shoot pun here

pp-bizon-urban-dashed.name: PP-Bizon | Urban Dashed
pp-bizon-urban-dashed.desc: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been spray-painted using short pieces of tape as stencils.

cz75-auto-slalom.name: CZ75-Auto | Slalom
cz75-auto-slalom.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been custom painted with a multicolored abstract design.

Black diamond gun

cz75-auto-green-plaid.name: CZ75-Auto | Green Plaid
cz75-auto-green-plaid.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a taupe and blue-green plaid pattern.

It's not a bagpipe, but it plays a song before every funeral

dual-berettas-mystic-conjunction.name: Dual Berettas | Mystic Conjunction
dual-berettas-mystic-conjunction.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been custom painted with gold, flowing lines which merge into a desert eye when overlaid.

A shared vision

dual-berettas-duelist.name: Dual Berettas | Duelist
dual-berettas-duelist.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been given painted mother-of-pearl grips and a dark forced patina.

Square gum not included

five-seven-crimson-blossom.name: Five-SeveN | Crimson Blossom
five-seven-crimson-blossom.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. A wine colored rose bud hydrographic pattern has been applied.

No rose without a thorn

galil-ar-amber-fade.name: Galil AR | Amber Fade
galil-ar-amber-fade.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

glock-18-snack-attack.name: Glock-18 | Snack Attack
glock-18-snack-attack.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted to resemble junk food trinkets suspended in resin.

The snack that fights back

glock-18-ocean-topo.name: Glock-18 | Ocean Topo
glock-18-ocean-topo.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A blue topographic pattern has been applied.

"Yeah, I saw that too..."

p2000-red-fragcam.name: P2000 | Red FragCam
p2000-red-fragcam.desc: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted using a hydrographic of a polygonal camo.

survival-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Survival Knife | Boreal Forest
survival-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

paracord-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Doppler
paracord-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Flip Knife | Safari Mesh
flip-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

gut-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Gut Knife | Doppler
gut-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

gut-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Gut Knife | Gamma Doppler
gut-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

gut-knife-freehand.name: ★ Gut Knife | Freehand
gut-knife-freehand.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

karambit-lore.name: ★ Karambit | Lore
karambit-lore.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

karambit-crimson-web.name: ★ Karambit | Crimson Web
karambit-crimson-web.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

ursus-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Doppler
ursus-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

talon-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Talon Knife | Doppler
talon-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m249-magma.name: M249 | Magma
m249-magma.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has copper plated parts that have been masked in a magma pattern and given a red patina using sodium chloride and high heat.  Unmasked areas have subsequently been darkened via oxidization using liver of sulfur.

A burning rate of fire

m249-nebula-crusader.name: M249 | Nebula Crusader
m249-nebula-crusader.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been custom painted to look like a classic arcade cabinet.

You can use it, but you better put up a quarter first

m249-warbird.name: M249 | Warbird
m249-warbird.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. Originally blue with a yellow heat shield, age and use have taken their toll on its appearance.

This old bird deserves a rest

m4a4-poseidon.name: M4A4 | Poseidon
m4a4-poseidon.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a depiction of a battle between Pisces and Poseidon.

Three can keep a secret if two of them are dead

m4a4-royal-paladin.name: M4A4 | Royal Paladin
m4a4-royal-paladin.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been painstakingly etched and painted to give a sense of grandeur.

This phonecall never happened, do you understand? - The Paladin and the Father Part 1

m4a4-zirka.name: M4A4 | Zirka
m4a4-zirka.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. This memento from Cache has been painted with a star motif.

Imogen shares her father's eye for quality, but her ambition is even fiercer

mac-10-arabesque-mosaic.name: MAC-10 | Arabesque Mosaic
mac-10-arabesque-mosaic.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted with a moving pattern of Middle Eastern-inspired scenery.

Ever-shifting sands

mac-10-bronzer.name: MAC-10 | Bronzer
mac-10-bronzer.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted using solid bronze and brown colors.

Not to be confused with "foundation"

mp5-sd-gold-leaf.name: MP5-SD | Gold Leaf
mp5-sd-gold-leaf.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. A green and gold hydrographic camo pattern has been applied.

"Can you take that outside?"

mp7-sunbaked.name: MP7 | Sunbaked
mp7-sunbaked.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. The lines of this custom paint job resemble grooves on a topographical map.

Bleed between the lines

mp9-hot-rod.name: MP9 | Hot Rod
mp9-hot-rod.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent red anodized effect paint.

Automatic. Systematic. Hydromatic.

mp9-arctic-tri-tone.name: MP9 | Arctic Tri-Tone
mp9-arctic-tri-tone.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. This custom paint job features white and blue color blocking and is finished with a matching camouflage.

Frigid finality

mp9-starlight-protector.name: MP9 | Starlight Protector
mp9-starlight-protector.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. This custom paint job features a unicorn with a rainbow mane atop a white base. It has been finished with gold accents.

May the deity protect you, should the deity select you

negev-prototype.name: Negev | Prototype
negev-prototype.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been custom painted in white and red, a temporary paint job while its design is finalized.

v1.2.1, PAT. 3422107

negev-phoenix-stencil.name: Negev | Phoenix Stencil
negev-phoenix-stencil.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. A multicolored pattern of various Phoenix Connexion graffiti has been applied.

"We cannot be killed!"

p250-contamination.name: P250 | Contamination
p250-contamination.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted with a hydrographic pattern of nuclear skulls and bones.

p90-traction.name: P90 | Traction
p90-traction.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with sectioned blue hexagons designed to fit the P90's unique shape.

Half the battle is keeping a hold of the weapon; the other half is hitting the target

p90-teardown.name: P90 | Teardown
p90-teardown.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been spray-painted freehand using mesh fabric as a stencil.

p90-verdant-growth.name: P90 | Verdant Growth
p90-verdant-growth.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been spray-painted with a flower pattern in various shades of green.

Some see a nuisance; I see beauty

r8-revolver-llama-cannon.name: R8 Revolver | Llama Cannon
r8-revolver-llama-cannon.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. Its ivory handle is paired with ornate, engraved flourishes on blue metalwork.

Pull the lever

sawed-off-crimson-batik.name: Sawed-Off | Crimson Batik
sawed-off-crimson-batik.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. A crimson and black banana leaf pattern has been applied.

Moving targets

sg-553-heavy-metal.name: SG 553 | Heavy Metal
sg-553-heavy-metal.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. Its black base is finished with orange and yellow highlights. Three stars have been painted on the rear of the butt stock.

"One of these studs is the Turbo button, I just can't remember which…"

tec-9-cut-out.name: Tec-9 | Cut Out
tec-9-cut-out.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. An intricate pattern of butterflies and floral details has been applied.

Spring has sprung

usp-s-blueprint.name: USP-S | Blueprint
usp-s-blueprint.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been hand painted using a blue theme to resemble an architect's blueprint.

Sometimes the best-laid plans go awry

usp-s-27.name: USP-S | 27
usp-s-27.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. This custom paint job features a winged defuser beneath the rear sight and "027" near the ejection port.

Light field work

xm1014-quicksilver.name: XM1014 | Quicksilver
xm1014-quicksilver.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been painted using a translucent hydrographic with a terrain map motif over metallic silver paint.

Sometimes you need an unstable element to solve your problems - Kotaro Izaki, Breach Expert
